## Mediated Interactions

::: column-margin
An interaction is **mediated** when some technology (e.g., writing or digital interaction) is the way that at least two people connect.
:::

`One key technology we have discovered, a means of materializing our culture, is through the mediation of interaction.  That is, there we can have interactions with others, and ourselves, via a set of traces exchanged intentionally or not.  These span everything from moves in games, to built structures, to writing, to digital ineractions.`
